{{Quote|The Boonta is far more dangerous than any amateur race I've flown!|[[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]|<ref name="Podracing Tales">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
The '''Boonta Eve Classic''' was the largest annual [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Held on the planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], it was hosted by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to commemorate the [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]] holiday. Located just outside [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], the Boonta race course started in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]]. There, thousands of spectators would congregate, hoping to see their favored racer win, to catch a glimpse of a spectacular collision, or to win a fortune gambling on the race's outcome.

==The Ceremony==
The formal race ceremony started with a parade of flag-bearers; each carried a racer's distinctive emblem, and lined up before the starting grid. Once the bearers cleared the grid, the Podracers' massive engines would roar to life, seemingly anxious at the chance to soar at speeds exceeding 700 kilometers-per-hour.

==The Mos Espa circuit==
[[File:ITW1_Boonta_Circuit.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Mos Espa circuit.]]
The Mos Espa course mostly turned around [[Ben's Mesa/Legends|Ben's Mesa]]. It blazed out of the arena onto the [[Starlite Flats]], an easy stretch of desert where aggressive Podracers jockeyed for strong starting positions. The racers had to line up in single file to enter the curving canyon that cuts through the [[Waldo Flats/Legends|Waldo Flats]]. This opened up into [[Mushroom Mesa/Legends|Mushroom Mesa]], a rocky expanse dominated by immense bulbous rock formations. [[Metta Drop]], a sudden escarpment, dropped the racers onto [[Ebe Crater Valley/Legends|Ebe Crater Valley]], where they again had to navigate a narrow opening ([[The Notch/Legends|the Notch]]) to enter [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

[[File:Podrace_announcers.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed]] gives commentary on the Boonta Eve Classic.]]
The race then continued onto a length of desert plains abutting the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. One of the most hazardous areas&mdash;[[Arch Canyon/Legends|Arch Canyon]]&mdash;forced pilots to maneuver through stone wickets before entering another series of canyons, including [[The Whip/Legends|The Whip]], [[Jag Crag Gorge/Legends|Jag Crag Gorge]], and the subterranean [[Laguna Caves/Legends|Laguna Caves]]. Emerging from the caves, the pilots careened through the tight [[Canyon Dune Turn/Legends|Canyon Dune Turn]], known to be a campsite for vengeful [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

Podracers that survived potshots from the Sand People then had to dodge the rocky obstacles in [[Bindy Bend/Legends|Bindy Bend]] before entering the last stretch of canyon, which included [[The Coil/Legends|The Coil]], [[Jett's Chute/Legends|Jett's Chute]], and [[The Corkscrew/Legends|The Corkscrew]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

Exiting the Corkscrew via the [[Devil's Doorknob/Legends|Devil's Doorknob]], the pilots emerged onto the [[Hutt Flats/Legends|Hutt Flats]], a broad featureless expanse that led back to the arena. This entire circuit represented one lap, and the Boonta Eve Classic required three laps for completion,<ref name="ItWoSWE1" /> with an average time of 5 minutes, 20 seconds for each lap.

Commentaries were made by [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed]], a popular commentator in the sport.

==History==
===Renaissance under Gardulla===
The Boonta Eve Classic circuit was an ancient course that had fallen on hard times by [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. With the financial support of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], however, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] restored the course as part of an effort to seize control of Tatooine, creating a new Podracing circuit that would rival those of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

===The race of 32 BBY===
{{Quote|Oh, I don't care what universe you're from. That's gotta hurt!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:Podrace.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Plug-F ''Mammoth'']] vs [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's podracer]].]]

====Prelude to the Race====
Only a few days before, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had to land the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on the planet of Tatooine. After discovering that the only way to obtain a replacement [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|hyperdrive generator]] was to pay with Tatooine currency, Jinn found the young boy Anakin Skywalker in [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] shop. Jinn met Anakin's mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]], and Anakin eagerly offered to use his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] in the race, to obtain the parts needed for the Naboo ship, if he won.

Qui-Gon also worked out a deal, that if Anakin won the race, he would have his freedom.

====The Race====
[[File:Jabba_anouncements.png|thumb|right|200px|Jabba opens the race]]

When the start lights flashed green, all pilots hit the thrusters and sped away, except for two, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. Anakin managed to get his pod working and soon followed the rest of the racers. In the meanwhile, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] had pushed [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic's]] podracer into the cliff wall, destroying his pod. Mawhonic survived the crash and he put a bounty on at least two members of Sebulba´s family, the bounty was claimed by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Anakin moved up by overtaking [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]], [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]], [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]], and [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]]. As the racers approached Laguna Cave, Anakin raced past [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]] and [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe Endocott]] moving up behind [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]]. In the [[Laguna Caves/Legends|Laguna Caves]], Tyerell crashed into a stalactite, and was killed upon impact. Exiting the cave, Anakin's pod was shot at by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. Meanwhile Ben Quadinaros's pod further malfunctioned as the power couplings deactivated. This resulted in the pod flying apart as the engines tore off in multiple directions, grounding Quadinaros. In the meanwhile, the first five podracers passed the finish: Sebulba, [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]], [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]], and [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]]. Mandrell took a pit stop in which his pit droid [[DUM-4/Legends|DUM-4]] destroyed his left engine.

In the second lap, Sebulba used an illegal hidden [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] to roast the engines of [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]], causing Holdfast to lose control and crash into the canyon wall. Meanwhile, Anakin was behind Gasgano, and when he tried to go around him, Gasgano went in the same direction, blocking him. This happened again twice until they came to a ramp, where Anakin seized the chance and boosted in mid-air, getting past Gasgano. He also avoided being destroyed by Teemto Pagalies when a bug flew into his eye, and he lost control of his podracer. After passing [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], Anakin moved up to third place, behind [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]]. Sebulba tossed a piece of metal in Guo's colossal engine, destroying it. Guo crashed, and a piece of wreckage took out one of Anakin's cables. Anakin was overtaken by Gasgano, [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]], and [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]] while he fixed the cable. He then raced by the three that had overtaken him. Now behind Sebulba, Anakin sped through the Canyon Dune Turn, where his pod took another shot from the Tuskens. Teemto Pagalies, wasn't so lucky, as his pod's fuel tank took a hit, causing him to crash. The Tusken Raiders shot [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] that were picking up some parts from Pagalie's podracer. Sebulba attempted to use his flamethrower on Anakin, but he avoided it. [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]] wandered off course in the second lap in Hutt Flats, never to be seen again.

[[File:Boonta_final_lap.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Plug-F ''Mammoth'']] vs [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's Podracer]].]]

In the third lap, Anakin and Sebulba were racing side-by-side, for nearly the entire lap. A little bumping in Beggar's Canyon forced Anakin onto a service ramp where he fell a little behind. A quick control thrust allowed Anakin to leap over Sebulba to take the lead heading into Arch Canyon. The lead was short-lived as Anakin was forced to deal with a malfunctioning engine due to Sebulba's sabotage prior to the race. He fell behind as he made on-the-fly repairs. Some other racers crashed during the third lap, like [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]] and Ark Roose, who collided with each other, destroying both pods. [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]] lost control and crashed into a wayward [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawler]]. After getting his engine running, Anakin sped forward and caught Sebulba before entering the Hutt Flats at the Devil's Doorknob. At the end of the lap, Anakin and Sebulba's cockpits became entangled. Anakin used a boost to cut them loose, and Sebulba's engines detached and crashed. Anakin took the victory and was awarded the [[Boonta Cup]]. [[File:BoontaCelebration-SWE.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The celebration after Skywalker's victory]]

====Anakin Skywalker's triumph====
{{Quote|It's Skywalker!|Fodesinbeed as Anakin crosses the finishing line|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
Even though the odds favored the scheming [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] as a victor, [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was with Anakin, and he came in first. It was a stunning upset to the longstanding [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] champion. He became the first human to win the race. Anakin won more than the race; the young slave also won his freedom.

Word spread that the race results cost the notorious gambler [[Romeo Treblanc]], the owner of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] on Coruscant, a fortune.<ref name="DarthPlagueis">''[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|Darth Plagueis]]''</ref>

Ten years later in the Clone Wars, Skywalker took a [[Mission to Mon Gazza]], where he had his Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] race due to fearing people would recognize him from winning the Boonta Eve, when he was 9, which he told Tano many times. After the mission, upon hearing Tano mention Skywalker, a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]], named [[Kidd Kareen]], reconized Anakin, which he recalled that his own parents began training him as a podracer before he could even walk.

Almost seventy years later, the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] recalled that Anakin won the race by breaking no rules, in a race with no rules.

===Boonta Eve Classic (1 BBY)===
[[File:StarTours2_bg.jpg|thumb|250px|Star Tours' accidental involvement in the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine.]]
Despite the Empire's ban on [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], the Boonta Eve Classic continued to be an ongoing tradition on Tatooine. During one race taking place during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]-owned ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'', the [[Star Tours Flight 1401]], accidentally participated in the race shortly after escaping from [[Spaceport THX1138]] due to an Imperial [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]]. Several podracers ended up destroyed in the hectic events before it left. The Boonta Eve Classic was popular enough that the Star Tours agency had a lot of passengers leaving for Tatooine for that very reason.<ref name="ST:TAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Legacy==
[[File:Tatooine_ghost_illustration_scene.jpg|thumb|215x215px|An undercover Leia learns of her father's past as a local hero.]]
Many years later in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] eventually wrote an article about the Boonta Eve. This article was found by Anakin’s son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] who traveled to Tatooine.<ref name="“New">’’[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]</ref>

Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] visited the site of the race while on a mission on Tatooine and even viewed a [[Holocube/Legends|holocube]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] from his friend, [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], photographed shortly after his victory. The Boonta Eve Classic was also featured in one of [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars's]] [[Holojournal/Legends|holojournal]] entries that Leia found on the [[Lars homestead/Legends|old Skywalker homestead]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the audio commentary on the Episode I DVD, visual effects supervisor [[John Knoll]] points out that in a shot of the scene of Sebulba riding just behind Anakin, with Anakin's head nearly in the connecting current between the pod engines, it is possible to see that Sebulba is not present in his pod. The same can be said for a deleted scene in which Sebulba flames the pods of Clegg Holdfast (who is also missing in his pod).

The [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]], written by [[Terry Brooks]] and published just before the release of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|film]] in [[1999]] states that racers [[Obitoki]], [[Habba Kee]], and [[Xelbree/Legends|Xelbree]] competed in this race. In the novel, Obitoki and Habba Kee [[Death/Legends|die]] in a crash caused by Sebulba and they appear in the script in the same context,<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> but neither makes an appearance in the film itself. Additionally, ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' establishes that eighteen racers qualified and competed in the Boonta Eve Classic, but these three are not on the provided list. This article thereby treats Obitoki's appearance in the novel as ambiguously [[canon]]ical. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' was released in [[2008]]. Its entry on Obitoki confirms the existence of Kee and Obitoki and their crash, but it leaves the wreck's occurrence during the Boonta and their deaths ambiguous. Xelbree also received a mention in that reference book.
[[File:PodraceGridAnimaticPhase.jpg|right|297x297px|The animatic stage of the Boonta Eve Classic grid, which featured many of the scrapped racers.]]
During production, there were several podracer pilots who did make the cut, but did appear in the animatics phase alongside concept art. These podracer pilots included [[Bozzie Baranta]], [[Toy Dampner]], [[Navior]], [[Slide Paramita]] and [[Fud Sang/Legends|Fud Sang]]. Eventually, they all made their full appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.
